newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB Australian wheat indicator prices -Oct 29.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB Australian wheat indicator prices -Oct 29.

text.p: International prices for milling and Durum wheat were lower as recent export business was regarded as disappointing. The Australian dollar firmed overnight, the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said.
Wheat indicator prices for multi-grade contracts for 1996/97 crop wheat fell A$2.00 while Durum fell A$0.50.
Prices, FOB, in A$ per tonne:

NOTE: The indicator price represents the current state of the international wheat market. It is a cash contract price offered today by the AWB for wheat delivered during the 1996/97 harvest. The offer is valid until 4.30 p.m. Australian Eastern Standard Time (0630 GMT) and Eastern Standard Summer Time (0530 GMT). Indicator prices will be revised daily until October.
